evaluation.reports_split_by_mode: json-prefill none=free_raw / object=object_prefill / schema=schema_assisted. 未指定時は eval/{run_slug}/{eval_mode}/report.json と docs/{run_slug}_{eval_mode}_{date}.md に自動分離される。
evaluation.zero_shot_command_schema_assisted: uv run python tools/qwen_lora_eval.py --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct --cases data/navspec/lora/raw_baseline_122_plus_500/cases.jsonl --json-prefill schema
evaluation.zero_shot_command_free_raw: uv run python tools/qwen_lora_eval.py --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct --cases data/navspec/lora/raw_baseline_122_plus_500/cases.jsonl --json-prefill none
evaluation.stage1_adapter_eval_command: uv run python tools/qwen_lora_eval.py --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct --adapter-path models/navspec-lora-0.5b-v0.1/adapter/stage1-r8 --cases data/navspec/lora/raw_baseline_122_plus_500/cases.jsonl --json-prefill schema

training.mask_prompt: schema_only SFT では応答のみで loss を取るため --mask-prompt を必ず有効化する。qwen_lora_train.py が schema_only データ学習時に未指定なら自動で --mask-prompt を補強する(NAVSPEC_NO_MASK_PROMPT=1 で opt-out)。
training.stage1_schema_only_command: uv run python tools/qwen_lora_train.py --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct --train --data data/navspec/lora/schema_only_v0 --adapter-path models/navspec-lora-0.5b-v0.1/adapter/stage1-r8 --iters 1000 --batch-size 1 --num-layers 16 --learning-rate 0.0001 --mask-prompt
training.note: Run only after mlx-lm and the Qwen base model are available locally or download access is approved.
